testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel browsing for a drawing-layout component ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-layout-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔ Given a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/document-creation-layout-candidate/English/layout-data/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is active ✔ And the active part has been updated and then edited so that it needs updating again ✔ And `fixtures/cad/document-creation-layout-candidate/English/Populated Layout.odd` is available as a drawing layout with a view and parts list ✔ And the user selects the assembly layout and opens its component-selection dialog ✔ And the dialog displays the active part ✔ When the user chooses Browse beside the document name ✔ Then a file-selection dialog opens above component selection ✔ And it displays a folder and file list, a file name field and a file-type filter ✔ And it displays a preview area and Open and Cancel controls ✔ When the user cancels the file-selection dialog ✔ Then the component-selection dialog is displayed again ✔ And its previous document name remains displayed ✔ When the user cancels component selection ✔ Then the original document remains active ✔ And no new drawing tab is displayed
